_note: B-46 business email compromise containment plan. `order` is the order of the steps; `steps` names the lever each one dry-runs. Lever param names were read from levers/registry.json and levers/registry.d/*.json. The disable-rules step expands to one inboxrule.disable per flagged rule that is on. Nothing here is per person or per client.
